flagged.location: Proof step 1.1, sentence beginning “Every handle body of this presentation”
flagged.evidence: The current proof says, “Every handle body of this presentation is the same subset of W as in any other presentation.” But `thm-creation-of-a-cancelling-handle-pair` constructs a presentation by adding a cancelling pair and states that the resulting manifold is diffeomorphic to W relative to the incoming face. The added handle bodies are absent from the original presentation, so handle bodies are not presentation-independent. Duality identifies bodies within a fixed presentation and its reversed dual.

The title says, “Homotopy spheres bounding a contractible manifold are standard spheres,” without a dimension restriction. The Statement and proof require n≥5, so the title asserts more than the item establishes.
